title: Email to Tybalt about the rule
subject: Versioning with Montague

blocks.text: Romeo and I settled field versioning for Schema Bridge this afternoon. The rule: Capulet owns the inspection record schema, Montague owns the routing envelope around it, and any change to either needs both sides to approve. Every event will carry a schema_version, so an old tablet sending old events doesn't confuse anyone.
It covers only the inspection record we send over the bridge. It doesn't touch Balcony's internals or how we build anything on our side.
I know you've had worries about leaning on Montague. I'd rather hear them now than after Friday's demo, so send me whatever's on your mind.
